relations.note: Later mythographic synthesis presents Earth as Ilargi’s mother.

relations.myth: Earth creates Moon to protect humans from nocturnal beings
relations.note: Expanded modern cosmogony says Earth deliberately created Ilargi as protection.

relations.myth: Moon returns nightly into Earth after crossing the sky
relations.note: Later synthesis extends the celestial earth-return motif to Ilargi.
Modern handbooks commonly present Moon and Sun as Earth’s sister daughters.
Modern summaries describe the Moon as God’s face.

relations.myth: Lunar greeting becomes a Christianized Saint Clare song
relations.note: At Ondarroa, Saint Clare substitutes for Moon in the greeting formula.
relations.source: Barandiarán, La religion des anciens Basques
